bootstrap.limitation: within-landscape spatial uncertainty only; not uncertainty over the population of volcanoes
bootstrap.method: resample held-out 3 km blocks with replacement; identical draws across models within landscape

calibration.next_stage: final recalibration, categories and reliability are explicitly deferred
calibration.reporting: raw Brier/log loss, calibration intercept/slope and reliability summaries; legacy Stage 4B-style inner Platt/F1 threshold only for continuity
calibration.selection: never used for primary architecture selection

catastrophic_guard.cotabato: EQ1 remains included but is already near-null: a candidate fails there only if candidate lift <0.80 and paired 95% upper CI for Delta PR(candidate-Logistic) < 0
catastrophic_guard.non_cotabato: where Logistic PR lift >=1.25, a candidate fails if paired 95% upper CI for Delta PR(candidate-Logistic) < 0 and either candidate lift <=1.0 or candidate lift <0.67*Logistic lift
catastrophic_guard.purpose: prevent an easy-landscape gain from hiding a major new transfer collapse without making the shared Cotabato EQ1 failure disqualifying

complexity.role: secondary; performance governs unless the frozen simplicity tolerance activates

controls.historical: reuse authoritative Stage 4B M/ME/MEG results for Logistic/RF/HistGB; never refit solely to create new values
controls.interpretation: E/G controls cannot become the primary architecture and cannot trigger feature engineering
controls.xgboost: after the primary XGBOOST+M result and selection freeze, fit XGBOOST+ME and XGBOOST+MEG with the same nested architecture as secondary historical controls

cotabato.primary: COTABATO_DAVAO_2019 EQ1 frozen y_positive; never excluded or replaced
cotabato.prohibition: sensitivity labels cannot tune, select, change features, alter the rule or replace EQ1
cotabato.timing: score cumulative labels only after primary M selection metrics and decision are frozen

ensemble.prohibition: no ensemble fitting, averaging, weight optimisation or leader replacement in Stage 4E-B
ensemble.status: feasibility diagnostic only after individual results freeze

features.no_feature_engineering: no post-result feature engineering; frozen 60-column M; no new M/E/G; no E1/E2/E3; H absent

importance.logistic: standardised coefficients from training-only scaling, summarised across folds
importance.method: held-out permutation PR-AUC drop on all positives plus 20,000 deterministic negatives; three repeats per fold
importance.selection: importance cannot alter features or select the model
importance.trees: model-agnostic permutation importance; native impurity/gain may be a labelled secondary diagnostic only

lockbox: no future lockbox is named, loaded, inspected or scored; all six landscapes are development-exposed

metrics.primary: PR-AUC (average precision) from raw held-out scores
metrics.primary_transfer: PR_LIFT = PR-AUC / held-out EQ1 prevalence; six landscapes are six transfer experiments
metrics.prohibited: pooled terrain-unit performance is never the primary transfer metric and PR-AUC is never called accuracy
secondary: F1 at the training-only Stage 4B-style threshold

ood: no final OOD thresholds, adjustment or OOD-based selection; Stage 4D confounding finding retained

selection.logistic_rule: if the raw-best complex model's score advantage over LOGISTIC_L2 is <= 5% of abs(LOGISTIC_L2 score), select LOGISTIC_L2
selection.no_clear_leader: only if every non-null candidate fails the catastrophic guard or a required metric is non-finite; otherwise exactly one leader
selection.raw_ranking: among candidates passing the catastrophic guard, greatest ROBUST_SCORE; exact ties (1e-12) use COMPLEXITY_ORDER
selection.runner_up: highest-ranked eligible model other than the selected leader after applying the same score and exact-tie ordering
selection.score: ROBUST_SCORE = 0.70*log(MEDIAN_LIFT) + 0.30*log(WORST_LIFT); all lifts must be finite and > 0
selection.selection_margin: selected ROBUST_SCORE minus RUNNER_UP ROBUST_SCORE; may be negative when the preregistered simplicity override selects Logistic
selection.uncertainty_rule: also select LOGISTIC_L2 when raw-best median PR-AUC improvement is <=0.002 AND the 95% paired bootstrap interval for the median six-landscape PR-AUC difference includes zero

stability.method: remove one of the six already-computed outer results, recompute summaries/ranking without retraining
stability.report: five-landscape wins, leader changes, driving landscape, Noto and Atitlan dependence

status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY STAGE 4E-B MODEL FIT

validation.held_out_rule: no held-out Y, X summary, sampling, threshold, calibration or score may affect training or tuning
validation.inner: within each outer fold, leave one of the five training landscapes out; the outer landscape is absent from all tuning
validation.inner_selection: maximum unweighted mean inner-landscape PR-AUC; configurations within 0.005 use the earliest grid entry
validation.outer: leave one whole landscape out; train on five; evaluate every unit of the held-out landscape
validation.preprocessing: none for tree models; Logistic historical predictions retain training-only Stage 4B z-scaling
validation.sampling: Stage 4B exact rule: every positive plus at most 20,000 negatives per training landscape, selected by the frozen terrain-unit hash order
validation.weighting: Stage 4B landscape-balanced sampling-corrected weights; every training landscape has equal total weight and retains its population prevalence
